digest.component_or_area: pytest test fixtures / subprocess environment handling
propositions: Seven decorated pytest fixtures return dict(os.environ) directly or nested, causing arbitrary ambient credentials to leak via pytest default long traceback rendering when fixture arguments are serialized by saferepr.

Minimal-environment test runs (env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin) pass all 42 affected fixture consumers, proving no behavioral dependency on arbitrary inherited environment variables beyond explicit allowlisted keys.

Each of the seven fixtures must replace broad os.environ copy with an explicit mutable allowlist containing only required PATH, state variables (STATE_DIR/DEPLOY_REPO/COMPOSE_DIR/MIRROR_DIR), and per-test overrides.
Deterministic RED/GREEN oracle with synthetic sentinels inserted first in environ confirms long traceback leaks ambient values from all seven fixture surfaces while short traceback does not.
